tasks.title: OMEL Wipe Witness module — scripts/lib/omel/wipe-witness.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/lib/omel/wipe-witness.ts. WipeWitness class: beforeWrite(filePath, agent_id) → WitnessToken (captures SHA-256 hash + size of file before write). afterWrite(token, newSizeBytes) → if new_size < 0.5 * old_size emit ShrinkAlert + Telegram alert. beforeDelete(filePath, agent_id) → log deletion event. getShrinkAlerts() → ShrinkAlert[]. All events to logs/omel/wipe-witness-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. Export singleton wipeWitness.
tasks.context: AMD-13 OMEL. WipeWitness is the detection layer that would have caught Sprint 171 destructive rewrites (qwen3:14b rewriting 2800-line files). SHA-256 reuse pattern from scripts/lib/aar-middleware.ts. Telegram alert via https pattern from scripts/lib/ceo-wallet.ts (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). Shrink threshold: new_size < 0.5 * old_size. File must be <300 lines. WitnessToken interface: { filePath, agentId, oldHash, oldSizeBytes, createdAt }. ShrinkAlert interface: { filePath, agentId, oldSizeBytes, newSizeBytes, ratio, ts }. If file does not exist before write (new file), beforeWrite() still returns a token but with oldSizeBytes=0 and oldHash=''. afterWrite() skips shrink check if oldSizeBytes===0.

JSONL audit to wipe-witness-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl. afterWrite skips shrink check when oldSizeBytes===0 (new file). Telegram: fire-and-forget https.request, silent on missing token/chatId. tasks.title: Wire wipeWitness into orchestrator executeTask — scripts/orchestrate-agents-v2.ts
tasks.description: 3 surgical edits to orchestrate-agents-v2.ts (FP-007: ~2990 lines — SURGICAL ONLY, no full rewrite). (1) Add import: import { wipeWitness } from './lib/omel/wipe-witness'; after credentialVault import. (2) In executeTask() before const result = await agent.execute(task, lastReview): add const witnessTokens = result.files?.map(f => wipeWitness.beforeWrite(f, task.agent)) ?? []; Wait — task result files are not known before execute(). Instead: capture file sizes before execute by reading task.deliverables.code files that exist. (3) After const result = await agent.execute(task, lastReview): iterate result.files and call wipeWitness.afterWrite() for each. Correct approach: (A) Before execute: const preTokens: Map<string,WitnessToken> = new Map(); for (const f of (task.deliverables?.code||[])) { if (existsSync(f)) preTokens.set(f, wipeWitness.beforeWrite(f, task.agent)); } (B) After execute: for (const f of result.files) { const tok = preTokens.get(f); if (tok) wipeWitness.afterWrite(tok, existsSync(f) ? statSync(f).size : 0); }
